sources.summary: British-Nigerian designer Yinka Ilori has brought a retro 1970s feeling to chairs, rugs, beds, lamps and cushions as part of a 40-piece collection for high-street furniture retailer Dunelm. Launched today, the Yinka Ilori x Dunelm collection is the designer's first full furniture and homeware collection.
